home.heroDesc: One system for the whole counter. Ring up sales, print BIR-ready receipts and see every branch from anywhere, even when the internet drops.
home.bandAlt: Ornate antique brass cash register on a shop counter
home.bandHeading: The till used to stay in the drawer
home.bandBody: Now it follows you. Check today’s sales from your phone, move stock between branches and close the day without counting twice.
home.day1Body: Count your starting cash and begin a session. Every peso from here on is tracked.
home.day2Body: Scan, tap, next. Stock drops with each sale, so nobody sells what is not on the shelf.
home.day3Body: You hear about the last few units before a customer finds an empty shelf.
home.day4Body: A paid Shopify or WooCommerce order comes in as a POS transaction. Stock updates on both sides.
home.day5Body: The drawer closes on schedule, shortages and overages are flagged, and your report is ready.
home.dayHeading: From opening float to final count
home.featuresDesc: Everything from the counter to the back office. Open any line to see what is included.
home.retailAlt: Produce section of a grocery store
home.retailDesc: Groceries, minimarts and shops with shelves to keep full: barcodes, variants, bundles and stock per branch.
home.generalAlt: Hardware store with goods stacked on shelves
home.generalDesc: Anything else that sells over a counter. Turn on only the modules you need.
home.ecomNote1Body: Sell in store or online and the other side updates, so you avoid overselling.
home.ecomNote2Body: Match products by SKU, pull product data and keep listings aligned.
home.ecomNote3Body: Paid online orders arrive as POS transactions, without duplicates.
home.ecomDesc: Connect Shopify or WooCommerce to your POS and keep one count of what you actually have.
home.appHeading: Your phone is a scanner too
home.appDesc: The 1pos companion app reads barcodes and QR codes with your camera and sends product photos straight to your catalog.
home.appPoint1: Scan to look up or add products
home.ctaHeading: Ring up your first sale today
home.ctaDesc: Set up your store, add a few products and try it at the counter. If it is not for you, walk away and owe nothing.
home.footerDesc: BIR-ready point of sale for Philippine stores, from the first scan to the end-of-day count.
home.footerMaker: 1pos is a product of Devcom Digital Marketing Services.
home.footerTagline: BIR-ready · {modules} modules · {languages} languages · Built for the Philippines
home.syncCaption: Offline sales wait here, then sync on reconnect
home.stepScanBody: Plug in a USB or wireless barcode scanner, or use a camera for QR codes. Products land in the cart with live stock checks.
home.stepScanP3: Search by name, SKU or barcode
home.stepScanAlt: Item passing over a red-lit checkout scanner
home.stepSellTitle: Take the money however it comes
home.stepSellBody: Cash, cards, GCash, Maya and QR payments at one till. Discounts, refunds and drawer counts are all built in.
home.stepSellAlt: Customer paying by phone at a checkout terminal
home.stepPrintBody: VAT is worked out for you and printed on any ESC/POS thermal printer. Prefer paper-free? Send it by email or PDF.
home.stepPrintAlt: Hands holding a printed receipt at a checkout terminal
home.stepSyncTitle: Every branch, one set of numbers
home.stepSyncBody: Each sale updates stock and reports across your branches. If the internet drops, keep selling; 1pos syncs when you are back online.

pricing.q1: Do I need a card for the trial?
pricing.a1: No. Sign up and your store runs for {days} days on the limits of the first plan listed here.
pricing.a2: Online through PayPal, from the subscription page inside your store.
pricing.a3: Yearly billing is twelve months at 10% off.
pricing.q4: What happens when I reach a limit?
pricing.a4: You can’t add more until you move up a plan. The sales limit starts over each month.
pricing.a5: USB and wireless barcode scanners, ESC/POS receipt printers, and a camera for QR codes, on plans that list scanners and printers.
pricing.q6: What if a payment is missed?
pricing.a6: Overdue invoices can pick up late fees. If the account is deactivated, a reactivation fee may apply.

about.heading: Made for the counter
about.intro: 1pos is a BIR-ready point of sale for Philippine stores. It takes the sale, tracks the stock and closes the day in one place.
about.photoAlt: Hardware store with goods stacked on shelves
about.makerBody: 1pos is a product of Devcom Digital Marketing Services. It’s built for the people behind the counter: owners, managers and cashiers who need the till to work, every day.
about.rule1Desc: When the connection drops, the till keeps working and syncs once it’s back.
about.rule2Desc: Every stock movement is recorded, and every cash drawer session ends with a count that shows any shortage or overage.
about.rule3Desc: VAT, official receipts and CAS reporting sit in the same system that rings the sale. What you get depends on your plan.
about.rule4Desc: Each store’s data stays apart from every other store’s, and changes leave an audit trail.

contact.heading: Ask at the counter
contact.intro: Pick what it’s about and your email app opens with the subject filled in.
contact.maker: 1pos is a product of Devcom Digital Marketing Services.
contact.include1Desc: The name after 1pos in your address, so we find the right store.
contact.include2Desc: What you were doing, what you expected, and what you got instead.
contact.include3Desc: If there’s an error on screen, a photo of it helps. Leave out passwords and customer details.
contact.ctaDesc: Find your store and log in from there.
